caseStudies.title: Real-time voice agents
caseStudies.summary: A real-time conversational voice-agent system connecting phone calls through Genesys to a streaming AI runtime, knowledge retrieval, and speech generation.
caseStudies.contribution: Designed and implemented the system, including Genesys connectivity, a reusable Python voice runtime, and bidirectional audio streaming.
caseStudies.challenge: Handling audio-format conversion, interruptions, connection recovery, and isolated state for each call.
details: Built Genesys connectivity for call-session lifecycle management, media-protocol handling, connection validation, control messages, playback notifications, and operational logging.
Implemented bidirectional audio streaming with audio-format conversion, interruption and barge-in handling, connection recovery, and isolated per-call state.
Created a reusable Python voice runtime for configuration loading, call coordination, typed state, tool registration, intent processing, retrieval, speech generation, and resource cleanup.
Implemented intent-aware orchestration for knowledge retrieval, follow-up questions, and customer-support interactions, with safeguards against unvalidated information in generated responses.
Added status acknowledgments matching the agent’s voice, cumulative turn timing, interruption-aware cancellation, and graceful timeout recovery.
Developed a browser voice client with microphone capture, audio playback, connection controls, real-time audio visualization, tool-execution states, and WebSocket connection recovery.
Containerized the voice service and integrated it into AWS deployment workflows with health checks, access controls, secrets management, centralized logging, and environment-specific configuration.
Added automated tests covering voice configuration, orchestration, retrieval, intent validation, latency management, audio protocols, WebSocket lifecycle, frontend behavior, and failure recovery.

caseStudies.title: AI workflow authoring and execution
caseStudies.summary: Visual authoring and execution tools for workflows with typed variables, API actions, conditional branching, escalation, and transitions between workflows and AI agents.
caseStudies.contribution: Owned features from requirements through release, building React/TypeScript authoring interfaces, Python/Pydantic APIs, OpenAPI contracts, and DynamoDB-backed data models.
caseStudies.challenge: Maintaining valid node references, version history, legacy compatibility, and session context through authoring, publication, and execution.
details: Developed visual authoring capabilities for typed variables, question and statement nodes, external API actions, query filters, conditional branching, escalation, and transitions between workflows and AI agents.
Implemented draft and publication lifecycles, version history, read-only previews, publish-time validation, and node-reference validation while maintaining compatibility with legacy workflow records.
Built session-context propagation across pre-chat workflows, customer-facing widgets, WebSocket services, and conversational AI pipelines.
Improved execution through variable normalization, conversation-history handling, execution recovery, message ordering, loop prevention, and human/AI handoffs.
Defined typed API contracts and persistence models for workflow definitions, execution state, node configuration, metadata, and versioned records.
Added unit tests covering workflow models, runtime behavior, API validation, persistence, publication checks, and frontend authoring components.
caseStudies.focus: Typed APIs · Version history · Workflow execution

caseStudies.title: ASSISTments
caseStudies.summary: Language model fine-tuning and retrieval augmented generation for feedback on student responses to math questions.
caseStudies.contribution: Fine-tuned large language models with QLoRA to enhance feedback accuracy for student responses to math questions.
details: Trained TensorFlow models on millions of student responses to develop and implement improvement strategies for student feedback.
Implemented a FAISS vector database for retrieval augmented generation to generate feedback and scores for student responses, improving large language model generated content accuracy by 30%.
